newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle priced higher for next week - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle priced higher for next week - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle will likely be priced $1.00 to $2.00 per cwt higher on a live basis next week and $2.00 to $3.00 higher on a dressed basis, after active sales this week depleted supplies, market sources said.
No sales were reported Friday, which sources said was expected after brisk activity earlier this week.
Also, a major snowstorm that hit the state Thursday brought transportation to a halt in many areas. Six to seven inches had fallen in some areas, sources said.
Next week's cattle were expected to be priced from $69.00 to $70.00/live basis and $111.00 to $112.00/dressed basis.
